transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... hi. I guess I'm here because... well, I have these times where I eat. A lot. And afterward, I just... I feel really gross. I get really disappointed in myself, like I should have more control over it. It just... I don't know, I end up writing some pretty awful things about myself in my journal. So... yeah. That's why I came in.
After these episodes of eating a lot, do you ever try to compensate by making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising a lot more than usual?
Um... no. I don't... I don't do any of that. I don't make myself sick or take anything. I just... no.
Do these episodes of eating a lot happen more when you're feeling stressed, upset, or emotional, or do they seem to happen regardless of how you're feeling?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't really thought about it like that. I guess they just... happen.
Do you usually feel stressed, sad, or upset before these episodes of eating a lot?
I don't know... maybe? I haven't really noticed a pattern. It just... happens.
When you're eating a lot during these episodes, do you feel like you can't stop eating or control how much you're eating?

Um... yeah, I guess. It's... once I start, I just kind of keep reaching for the next thing. Almost automatically. Even if I'm thinking in my head, like, 'Fumi, stop, you have sketches to finish'... I just don't. I don't really stop until the food is gone. Or... until I just feel too uncomfortable.
After these episodes where you feel like you can't stop eating, do you feel intense guilt, shame, or distress about what happened?

Yeah... um, I do. That's actually kind of why I decided to come in. I just feel... really gross afterward. And disappointed in myself. Like I should have more control over it. I usually just... I don't know, I end up writing some pretty awful things about myself in my journal.
How often do these episodes happen? Are they happening at least once a week?

Um... yeah, I guess so. For the past several months, it's... usually at least once a week. I'll get off work and just... buy too much food and eat it all at once. I don't think there's been a month recently where it stopped for more than a week or so.
During these episodes when you're eating a lot, do you feel like you've completely lost control over your eating, like you can't stop even if you wanted to?

Um... I think I mentioned this already, but... yeah. It's like I was saying before. Once I start, it's just... automatic. Even if I'm telling myself to stop, I just... I don't. Not until it's all gone or I physically can't eat anymore.
Do you find yourself eating much more rapidly than normal during these episodes?

Yeah... I guess I do. I just sort of... stand at the counter, or sit on my bed with my sketchbook, and... eat really fast. I don't really taste it. I just try to get it down before I think about it too much.
Do you usually eat alone during these episodes because you're embarrassed about how much you're eating?
Um... yeah. I guess so. I don't really want anyone to see me like that. So... yeah, I do it when I'm by myself.
